items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: They had the drummer Ram. He's still around here somewhere.

ctx.x: Were you up in San Francisco over that time or down there?

I'd go all over. I always had a car and that's how I used to make my living. I'd go up this far to Portland, Oregon. Just play around, play around and come back down. Then for about nine months, I worked on Market Street. I don't remember the years. It was the Balcony Ballroom when I had 11 pieces over there. So Oliver was out here and that's the time Dodge was with him. They had the drummer Ram. He's still around here somewhere.
I talked to him on the phone in Los Angeles.
